title: Job Union Scraper Input
description: Unified input schema that drives both the Google Jobs Scraper (johnvc/Google-Jobs-Scraper) and the LinkedIn Jobs Scraper (jungle_thunder/linkedin-jobs-scraper-free-trial). Fields are grouped by scope: orchestration, shared search, Google-specific, and LinkedIn-specific.

sources.title: Sources to scrape
sources.description: Which job platforms to query. Selecting both runs them in parallel.

deduplicateResults.title: Deduplicate results
deduplicateResults.description: When true, jobs that appear in both sources (matched by title + company + location) are merged into a single record carrying data from both sources.

outputNormalised.title: Output normalised schema
outputNormalised.description: When true, every job is emitted using the common normalised schema regardless of source. When false, the raw source payload is preserved alongside the _source and _normalisedAt fields.

apifyApiToken.title: Apify API token (optional)
apifyApiToken.description: Optional personal Apify API token used when calling child actors. Use this if the default run token lacks permissions.

query.title: Job search query
query.description: Primary search query sent to BOTH Google Jobs and LinkedIn (as the first / only jobTitle). Examples: 'Software Engineer', 'Data Scientist', 'Product Manager'.

location.title: Job location
location.description: Primary location sent to BOTH sources. Recommended to specify at city level for best results. For LinkedIn, this becomes the first entry in the locations list.

googleConfig.title: Google Jobs configuration
googleConfig.description: All settings specific to the Google Jobs Scraper (johnvc/Google-Jobs-Scraper). These are ignored when Google is not in 'sources'.

country.title: Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
country.description: E.g. 'us', 'uk', 'de'. Leave empty (None) to let Google infer from domain.

language.title: Language code
language.description: Language for Google results. Defaults to 'None' (Google infers).

google_domain.title: Google domain
google_domain.description: Which regional Google domain to query. Defaults to google.com.

num_results.title: Maximum number of results
num_results.description: Maximum Google job records to return. Defaults to 100.

max_pagination.title: Maximum pages
max_pagination.description: Maximum pages to paginate (~10 results each). Set to 0 for unlimited.

lrad_value.title: Location radius (km)
lrad_value.description: Radius in km when include_lrad is true. E.g. '5', '10', '25'.

max_delay.title: Request delay (seconds)
max_delay.description: Pause between Google API requests to avoid rate limiting.

linkedInConfig.title: LinkedIn Jobs configuration
linkedInConfig.description: All settings specific to the LinkedIn Jobs Scraper (jungle_thunder/linkedin-jobs-scraper-free-trial). These are ignored when LinkedIn is not in 'sources'. Free trial: 50 jobs; paid plan: up to 1000 per run.

totalJobs.title: Number of jobs to scrape
totalJobs.description: How many LinkedIn jobs to fetch. Free trial cap: 50. Paid plan: up to 1000 per run.

experienceLevel.title: Experience level
experienceLevel.description: Filter by one or more seniority levels. Leave empty to include all levels.

jobType.title: Employment type
jobType.description: Filter by one or more job types. Leave empty to include all types.

remoteFilter.title: Remote / On-site / Hybrid
remoteFilter.description: Filter by work arrangement. Leave empty to include all arrangements.

timePosted.title: Date posted
timePosted.description: Only return jobs posted within this window.

companyIds.title: Company IDs (optional)
companyIds.description: Restrict results to specific companies by their LinkedIn company IDs (numeric). Leave empty to search all companies.

includeDescription.title: Include full job descriptions
includeDescription.description: Fetch the complete job description for every listing. Slightly slower but returns full requirements and responsibilities text.

startOffset.title: Start offset (skip N jobs)
startOffset.description: Skip the first N results. Useful for pagination or resuming an interrupted scrape.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrency (speed)
maxConcurrency.description: Number of parallel requests. Higher values are faster but may be less stable. Recommended: 5 for stability, 10 for speed.
